Name: Ochre
Source: Sun-baked flakes of the Matriarch's skin, scraped from the Sunward Terraces of Varnish. The oldest pigment; every Limner starts here.
AttunementPassive: Maximum Glim +20 while Ochre sits in a palette well.
CombatModifier: Heavy attack becomes a thrust that leaves a thin warm glaze on the target for 6 s: it takes +15% damage from all sources and glows, raising ambient light by 0.25 within 4 m of it.
LoreLine: Earth that remembers an afternoon. It is the last warm thing most villages own.

Name: TerreVerte
Source: Green earth pressed from the moss that grows along the Matriarch's spine, wherever dusk light still reaches.
AttunementPassive: Stamina regeneration +20% while Terre Verte sits in a palette well.
CombatModifier: Heavy attack becomes a low 180-degree dry-brush sweep that ends in a 3 m backstep. Each use that hits refunds 15 Stamina. Hit, then be somewhere else.
LoreLine: Old masters laid green beneath every face so the skin would look alive. The god did the same with her.

Name: Sanguine
Source: Drawn from blood wells: small weeping bites the Madderbacks keep open along the Matriarch's spine. Also carried in the Madderbacks themselves.
AttunementPassive: Each killing blow restores 8 HP while Sanguine sits in a palette well.
CombatModifier: Heavy attack becomes a three-hit rushing flurry painted wet-on-wet in one breath. Each hit deals 0.6x heavy damage and heals you 4 HP. It commits you: no cancelling out of the flurry.
LoreLine: It is still warm when you take it. That is the whole of its virtue and the whole of its cost.

Name: BoneBlack
Source: Char scraped from dead bone spurs where the Matriarch's ribs and vertebrae break the surface.
AttunementPassive: Stagger damage dealt +15% while Bone Black sits in a palette well.
CombatModifier: Heavy attack becomes a slow overhead slam laid on thick: 1.4x heavy damage and 2x stagger damage. It leaves a 2 m smear of heavy paint for 3 s that slows enemies by 30%.
LoreLine: The only black that was ever alive. It gives a painting its weight, and a blow its end.

Name: Ceruse
Source: The chalky white residue an Erasure leaves when it is unmade. It cannot be harvested, only taken.
AttunementPassive: Harmful effects on you last 50% less time, but maximum HP is reduced by 15 while Ceruse sits in a palette well (the lead toll).
CombatModifier: Heavy attack becomes a fast scraping swipe. If it lands during an enemy's wind-up or active frames, that attack is cancelled. It also deletes projectiles. It cannot cancel WhiteFlash attacks.
LoreLine: The loveliest white there is, and it poisons everyone who grinds it. Use the enemy's own nothing against them.

Name: SlumberBlue
Source: Dream-condensate that beads on the inside of the Matriarch's ribs while she sleeps. It only forms in the dark, and it does not come back.
AttunementPassive: Dodge distance +20% while Slumber Blue sits in a palette well.
CombatModifier: Heavy attack becomes a 4 m blurred dash through the target. You cannot be hit for 0.25 s during it, and the target is Loosened (slowed 40%) for 3 s.
LoreLine: Edges go soft in a dream. Carry enough of this and they go soft around you too.
